name: Adcounty Media India Limited
sector: Digital performance marketing and advertising technology
summary: Adcounty is a performance-marketing/media-buying business trying to build a broader advertising-technology platform. Revenue growth and a substantial post-IPO deposit buffer are real strengths, but the apparent low earnings multiple masks a major development-cost question. FY2026 group PAT ₹20.2512 crore includes the benefit of ₹16.8451 crore capitalized development expenditure; the annual report calls it technical-staff salaries while the IPO monitor describes most capex utilization as purchased perpetual software rights. Neither description alone proves wrongdoing, but they imply different recurring economics. Consolidated negative CFO is also distorted by acquired-liability settlements, not simply all recurring collection failure. Completed deep assessment: conditional growth/special situation, not a demonstrated compounder. BQS 4.56 and Growth Quality 5.00 are cautious judgments under a reliability hold; IAS remains NS until the cost/funding bridge and BSE implementation conditions are resolved. A project-level reconciliation, collections and cash returns, not an AI label or lower P/E alone, would change the conclusion.

sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: Adcounty Media India Limited, BSE SME544435, ISIN INE0W1601012, listed July4,2025. Cutoff October20,2026; dated secondary close ₹81.03 on October19, not an exchange-verified executable bid. Verified22501200 shares imply ₹182.3272 crore market value; official current board lot800 costs ₹64824. Indian GAAP legacy FY2021/FY2022 is kept separate from Ind AS standalone FY2023–2025 and consolidated FY2026, which adds Dubai and Adaxx. Five-year horizon,15% nominal annual equity hurdle before investor tax and ₹5 lakh liquidity reference, not a suitable allocation recommendation. G1 conditional: disclosed related-party/legal issues but no proven issuer diversion. G2 hold: material development-cost nature/recognition bridge and financial presentation discrepancies. G3 conditional: no bank borrowing, but partner loan, leases, earmarked/pledged deposits and working-capital demands remain. G4 unresolved: complete secondary history helps but current BSE surveillance and executable depth are not independently verified. High confidence in identity and dated share count; Medium in reported audited balances and adverse cash sensitivities; Low in a point valuation until cost recurrence is reconciled.

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: Canonical factors: GOV4, MOAT4, REV7, DUR5, CAP3, CASH3, BAL7, EXEC5, EARN3. BQS contributions: .80+.80+.84+.50+.36+.30+.56+.40 =4.56 (20/20/12/10/12/10/8/8% weights). Growth Quality:2.80+1.00+.45+.45+.30 =5.00, with persistent weak-cash/capital-return cap5. IAS uses Q=BQS, R NS, D4, P4, L NS; no missing-factor reweighting. Quality scores are evidence-based but excluded from investable ranking by G2. The machine-readable audit below retains exact values, source-linked reasons, confidence, coverage and missing-data bounds. REV selects the comparable post-transition FY2023–2026 standalone endpoint proxy rather than the larger mixed-accounting five-year growth figure. EARN/CASH/CAP explicitly recognize the capitalization and acquisition-cash distinctions.

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: The company buys online advertising inventory and sells campaigns measured by installs, qualified leads, sales, clicks and other outcomes. FY2025 mobile-install commissions contributed44.47% and lead generation32.91%; cost-per-sale3.22%. Prospectus labels60.02% Adtech and39.98% digital marketing, but these labels are not separately audited SaaS recurring revenue. Platforms include BidCounty and later Opsis/iSearch/Adaxx offerings; revenue remains exposed to campaign budgets, attribution rules, traffic quality and publisher payments. FY2026 media procurement ₹49.9879 crore is58.05% of revenue, so gross billings are not software-like net revenue. Domestic revenue ₹79.236 crore and exports ₹6.873 crore compare with ₹52.4302/16.4649 crore previously: international narrative does not erase the export contraction.86 permanent staff are disclosed. Adaxx contributed only one month of FY2026 results; Dubai also changes scope.

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Campaign optimization experience, advertiser/publisher relationships and in-house tools can support repeat business, but there is no independent evidence of durable pricing power, retention-based recurring revenue or a network effect. IPO top-ten customers supplied70.30/77.98/76.94% of FY2023/2024/2025 revenue; FY2025 two major customers supplied about40.20%. FY2026 largest disclosed customer contributed ₹17.5151 crore,20.34%; the consolidated comparative table omits the former second major customer that appears in the standalone note, so this cannot establish broad diversification. Supplier/platform contracts are generally not long-term. Apple/Google/social-platform changes, privacy restrictions and fraud/attribution disputes are business-model risks, not predictions of a specific rule change. IPO comparators Affle and DAPS differ materially in scale and business mix; their old standalone multiples are not used as current valuation evidence. The monitor’s off-the-shelf-rights description weakens any automatic proprietary-software moat claim.

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: Original AS standalone FY2021/FY2022 revenue was ₹16.0914/30.9859 crore, PAT ₹.9708/2.0643 crore. Ind AS/restated FY2023/2024/2025 revenue ₹53.5652/42.6595/68.8951, followed by FY2026 standalone ₹84.7690 and group ₹86.1090. Annual comparable additions FY2024 −₹10.9057, FY2025 +₹26.2356, FY2026 parent +₹15.8739 crore show volatility, not uninterrupted compounding. FY2023–FY2026 parent CAGR16.53% maps to REV7; the mixed-AS/Ind AS FY2021–FY2026 39.42% growth is disclosed but not used as a directly comparable score. FY2026 group growth24.99% includes ₹1.34 crore subsidiary revenue; parent growth23.04%. June2026 quarter group revenue ₹25.2558 versus ₹17.0466 crore, up48.16%; parent ₹23.0777, up35.38%, with ₹2.1781 crore subsidiary contribution. Q1 group PAT ₹5.1406 versus ₹4.0964 crore, up25.49%; parent growth15.06%. These reviewed quarters contain no current cash-flow statement or development-cost rollforward and are not annualized mechanically.

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: The business can scale advertiser spend and publisher access, but customer acquisition, developer/platform spending and collection float consume capital. March receivables ₹45.5475 crore equal about193 closing-balance days versus161 previously; supplier advances ₹4.288 crore add funding need. IPO net objects include ₹25 crore WC and₹14 crore capex. March utilization leaves₹8.79 crore; June leaves₹8.10 crore, mostly₹8.07 WC, with₹8 crore deposits and₹.10 monitoring-account cash. The monitor reports no deviation but explicitly performs no audit. Its ₹13.97 crore capex use for perpetual standard-platform rights needs reconciliation to ₹16.8451 crore capitalized technical salaries and₹25.2746 crore total group development assets. Current launched-platform economics and useful life are unverified. For capital efficiency, conservative invested capital retaining deposits rises from equity+leases−free cash ₹35.1136 crore to equity+leases+partner loan−free cash ₹101.8563 crore. Full-development-cost normalized operating EBIT falls from roughly₹17.7841 crore to₹7.1284 crore; incremental NOPAT is negative. A five-year amortization sensitivity gives better earnings, but does not prove high cash returns on the new investment. CAP3/CASH3 cap Growth Quality at5.

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: March promoter group65.52%, no pledged promoter shares declared; later ownership is not independently verified. FY2026 four promoter executives received₹.24 crore each plus post-employment benefits; related media purchases₹2.1475 and related sales₹2.6848 crore were substantially below previous-year₹9.7537/12.0936. Related receivables₹3.2204 crore still merit collection checks. July shareholders approved ₹200 crore borrowing/guarantee/investment authorities, not sanctioned funding; overseas RPT limits Athena₹25, PK Expert₹10 and Aventuro₹10 crore. September approved Netsetgo/Surfer₹5 crore each, including permitted loans. Four executive salaries rise from₹2 lakh to₹5 lakh monthly from August1; new director Kumar Saurav receives₹5 lakh monthly from October1, taking aggregate five-person annual base run-rate to₹3 crore before allowances, versus₹.96 crore for the former four. Up-to20% future escalation is authorization, not automatic. The model charges the new cash-pay burden explicitly. Audits/IFC are unmodified and audit-trail reporting affirmative; two subsidiary auditors supply the group evidence. March Adaxx acquisition and September integration update are the same transaction, not two deals. IPO disclosures describe promoter Innovana/Chandan CBI/ED proceedings and the April2024 procedural release order with pending appeal as of the prospectus. No issuer involvement or conviction is inferred; current legal outcome is unverified. GOV4 reflects these specific allocation/disclosure concerns, not a blanket adverse character judgment.

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: FY2026 group revenue/PBT/PAT ₹86.1090/27.2921/20.2512 crore compares with₹68.8951/18.4012/13.7501. Other income₹3.441 includes₹1.7364 deposit interest,₹1.212 FX,₹.3714 balance-writeback and smaller gains. Removing all other income gives PBT₹23.8511. Full expense of newly capitalized₹16.8451 gives₹7.0060 pretax and₹4.9042–5.2545 PAT at30–25% tax; charging five-year amortization of all₹25.2746 development assets instead gives₹13.1573–14.0971 PAT. These are alternative sensitivities, not both deductions or corrected accounts. Acquisition adds₹8.4295 development assets already present in Adaxx before control. Group CFO−₹10.9123 versus parent+₹1.7448 includes acquired LLP trade-payable contraction₹10.093 and other-current-liability contraction₹3.0992 during March. Adding these₹13.1922 settlements gives a rough₹2.2799 group operating proxy, not an auditor-certified recurring CFO: acquired advances, taxes and other movements also matter. Development cash remains₹16.8451 and physical capex₹.1541, so even that proxy is about−₹14.7193 before lease principal/financing interest. Reported CFO less these capex items is−₹27.9115. Prior FY2025 CFO reclassifies from−₹.2309 to−₹3.3412 by moving₹3.1103 FD release to investing. IPO restated FY2023/2024 CFO1.4465/4.5443 differs from original1.9920/4.1413; retain separate series. Receivables over one year₹4.7957, including₹2.4305 over three years, carry no ECL. Cash₹8.1121, FD₹28.6658 and mutual funds₹1.2237 are real buffers, but₹4.639 FD is pledged and IPO cash earmarked. No bank borrowing does not mean debt-free:₹.2904 partner loan sits in other financial liabilities and leases total₹2.7214. Subsidiary consolidation-equity schedule prints₹116.9566 versus main balance-sheet₹106.9566, an apparent₹10 crore elimination mismatch requiring correction. Main BS reconciles; no invented restatement is imposed. GST claims₹.2161 remain contested.

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: At secondary ₹81.03, market value₹182.3272 crore is9.00x reported group PAT, not weighted-EPS-based8.40x. The normalization range is material: roughly12.94–13.86x if five-year development amortization is adequate, versus34.70–37.18x if new development spending is recurring expense; these alternatives are not interchangeable. The attached five-year model begins with actual WC₹43.6623 crore and₹32.1389 cash/nonpledged FD, with₹4.639 pledged FD excluded from operating liquidity and valued only at exit. IPO capex remaining₹.46 is paid once; WC allocation is consumed within incremental WC, not added again as cash. Already-completed capital contributions and acquired-liability settlements are not charged twice. Cash rent sits in operating margins, so lease debt is not subtracted again from a rent-adjusted earnings valuation. Base growth15/12/10/8/8%,27% margin before development and new management pay,10% revenue development cash,55% incremental WC and15x terminal NOPAT gives₹141.35 terminal price and11.32% illustrative return. Bull25/20/15/12/10%,30% margin,6% development and20x gives₹323.36/31.36%; bear gives₹5.97/−40.89%. All selected paths are funded if assumed nonpledged deposits are available. Development6/10/15/20% by multiples10/15/20 and12/15/18% hurdle-entry sensitivities are preserved. R remains NS: the source conflict determines whether a10% development burden is a sound base or an unsupported saving. A hypothetical return cannot resolve that gap.

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: The strongest bear argument is that a low headline P/E capitalizes profits before the economic cost of staying technologically competitive. Receivables then finance client campaigns while platform costs and higher salaries are paid in cash. The model stresses a25% first-year sales decline,22% pre-development margin,20% recurring development cost,60 extra collection days,50% loss of over-one-year receivables,15% supplier-advance loss and payment of the disclosed GST claim. It also repays the partner loan and opening tax/statutory dues, without rescue borrowing. Pledged FD and funds receive terminal haircuts. The modeled business uses its deposits to remain funded for five years but has almost no normalized terminal earnings; ₹5.97 residual price is severe impairment, not a forecast insolvency. If all₹24.0268 assumed available nonpledged deposits cannot be released on time, the same operating path has a cash gap; deposit maturity and earmarks therefore matter. D4 recognizes strong gross cash alongside genuine economic and collection risk. No observed default is asserted.

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: At unchanged22501200 shares,5x/10x the current secondary equity value means about₹911.64/1823.27 crore. Even at an illustrative20x sustainable earnings this needs₹45.58/91.17 crore PAT, compared with₹20.25 reported but only₹4.90–14.10 across the disclosed economic-cost sensitivities. Customer acquisition, collection float and recurring technology spending must scale together. The bull illustration does not reach5x over five years after execution costs; no probability of5x/10x is supported. A large market forecast, partner press release or software asset balance is not evidence of per-share compounding.

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Track: (1) a signed project/vendor/payroll bridge reconciling₹16.8451 staff capitalization with₹13.97 platform-rights utilization; (2) commercial readiness, useful lives and first amortization of₹25.2746 development assets; (3) receipts against₹4.7957 overdue beyond one year and whether loss allowances become necessary; (4) revenue growth versus closing debtor-days baseline193 and supplier advances₹4.288; (5) CFO after acquisition-settlement effects and cash technology reinvestment, not CFO/PAT alone; (6)₹8.10 June unspent IPO proceeds and deposit maturity/release, including Indusind November1; (7) actual RPT loans/transactions versus authorities, and five-executive pay run-rate; (8) parent versus acquired revenue/profit and repeat-customer economics; (9) tax and promoter appeal status without treating allegations as findings; (10) current BSE restrictions and executable turnover. Secondary OHLCV covers all60 dates in July24–October19: lower-bound mean₹28.8346 lakh, median₹23.56 lakh;20-date mean₹25.5468 lakh, median₹24.024 lakh. ₹5 lakh at5% of lower60 statistic implies4.2445 sessions,2%10.6112 and10%2.1222. No missing day is zero-filled. This supports starting L7 as a capacity proxy, not a final verified implementation score.800-share lots and master20% range are corroborated, but current BSE surveillance, spread and depth are not. L remains NS with explicit proxy rather than asserting NSE-list absence clears BSE.

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Conditional growth/special-situation watchlist, with low cash-quality and reporting hold; not a buy recommendation or proven compounder. The deposit buffer and no drawn bank debt distinguish Adcounty from an immediately refinancing-dependent company. They do not establish that software spending or receivables will earn attractive returns. BQS4.56 and GQS5.00 are excluded from investment ranking under the identified G2 hold; IAS NS preserves return and implementation uncertainty. A materially lower price helps only after confirming sustainable development economics, recoverability and cash availability. Transparent project reconciliation, declining overdue receivables and positive post-technology-investment cash would improve the case; persistent capitalization without cash returns, opaque group funding or new unsupported leverage would weaken it.

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Linked sources are document-specific and as-of dated. Original versus restated PAT/OCI and cash-flow classifications are not silently merged: the IPO profit reconciliation starts from historical comprehensive income in some years, so its endpoints must not replace PAT. Acquisition special-purpose accounts were OCR-read and main Q1 tables visually checked. A statutory-company audit does not independently validate management’s platform addressable-market claims. June monitoring expressly relies on supplied information and is not an audit. Further open questions are development cost nature/useful life, current deposit releases and cash bridge, aged-debtor recoverability, updated promoter/pledge/legal status and current BSE restriction lists. The October8 Dailymotion partnership announcement was discovered through its exchange index but the primary attachment could not be read; no quantified revenue, exclusivity or moat is credited to it. Model margins, development ratios, tax25%,5% salary inflation, collection stress, multiples and FD-release timing are analyst scenarios, not guidance. No current peer multiple or spot FX assumption is invented.
